paragraphs: Rav Yosef son of Rava: Rava said, ‘My son Yosef is wise in the laws of tereifot like Rabbi Yochanan’: Chullin 28b. Rav Yosef son of Rav—it should read son of Rava—expounded in Rava’s name: Menachot 33b. He asked Rav Yosef: Yevamot 64b. Rav Yosef told Rav Yosef son of Rabbah—it should read Rava—‘In what was your father especially careful?’ He replied: ‘Tzitzit’: Kol Kitvei 118b, end. Rav Yosef asked Rav Yosef son of Rava: ‘How did your father act?’ Berakhot 13b; ‘Like whom did your father hold?’ Eruvin 82b. He sent to Rav Pappa: Gittin 40a, end, and Arakhin 23b. He spoke to his father: end of HaUmanin; Ein Tzadin 25b, son of Rabbah—it should read Rava. After his death his wife came before Rav Nechemyah son of Rav Yosef. Rabbi Abba was his son. Rav Chavivi. Rabbi Chanina—this requires examination. Rabbi Yannai and Nannai.
